title: Ghost and Deadline
author: Beatrix Dravenmoor
blurb: Lior Sandoval, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
